```{ojs}
kdeApi = {
  const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="quarto:offset"]');
  const offset = meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "./";
  const href = new URL(offset + "labs/kde-math.js", document.baseURI).href;
  try {
    return await import(href);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error("The laboratory script did not load: " + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)));
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
themeDark = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const read = () => document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => notify(read()));
  observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
  notify(read());
  return () => observer.disconnect();
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof bandwidth = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const seq = api.sequence(api.DEFAULTS.seed);
  const drawn = api.samplePrefix(seq, api.DEFAULTS.population, api.DEFAULTS.n);
  if (drawn.error) throw new Error(drawn.error);
  const ruled = api.silvermanNrd0(drawn.values);
  if (ruled.error) throw new Error(ruled.error);
  const start = ruled.value;
  const form = html`<form class="kde-field">
    <span id="kde-bandwidth-label">Bandwidth h</span>
    <div class="kde-h-row">
      <input name="slider" type="range" step="0.001" aria-labelledby="kde-bandwidth-label" aria-describedby="kde-control-hint">
      <input name="number" type="number" min="0.005" max="20" step="0.001" aria-label="Bandwidth h as a number">
    </div>
    <p class="kde-hint" id="kde-control-hint"></p>
    <p class="kde-field-note"></p>
  </form>`;
  form.querySelector("#kde-control-hint").textContent =
    `n is a prefix of ${api.MAX_N} draws from this seed. Changing h does not redraw them. Arrow keys move a focused slider. Shift changes h by 0.1 and n by 10.`;
  const note = form.querySelector(".kde-field-note");
  const publish = (value) => {
    note.textContent = "";
    form.slider.min = String(Math.min(0.02, value));
    form.slider.max = String(Math.max(2.5, value));
    form.slider.value = String(value);
    form.number.value = Number(value).toFixed(4);
    form.value = value;
  };
  publish(start);
  form.slider.addEventListener("input", () => publish(Number(form.slider.value)));
  form.slider.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (!event.shiftKey) return;
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight" && event.key !== "ArrowUp" && event.key !== "ArrowDown") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const dir = event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowDown" ? -1 : 1;
    const next = Math.round((Number(form.value) + dir * 0.1) * 1000) / 1000;
    if (!(next > 0) || next > 20) return;
    publish(next);
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  form.number.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const value = Number(form.number.value);
    if (!(value > 0) || value > 20 || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
      note.textContent = "Bandwidth must be a positive finite number no larger than 20. The previous value is still in use.";
      form.number.value = Number(form.value).toFixed(4);
      return;
    }
    publish(value);
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => event.preventDefault());
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof drawCount = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const form = html`<form class="kde-field">
    <span id="kde-n-label">Sample size n</span>
    <div class="kde-n-row">
      <input name="slider" type="range" min="2" max="${api.MAX_N}" step="1" aria-labelledby="kde-n-label" aria-describedby="kde-control-hint">
      <output class="kde-n-value" name="out"></output>
    </div>
  </form>`;
  const publish = (value) => {
    const n = Math.max(2, Math.min(api.MAX_N, Math.round(value)));
    form.slider.value = String(n);
    form.out.value = String(n);
    form.out.textContent = String(n);
    form.value = n;
  };
  publish(api.DEFAULTS.n);
  form.slider.addEventListener("input", () => publish(Number(form.slider.value)));
  form.slider.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (!event.shiftKey) return;
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight" && event.key !== "ArrowUp" && event.key !== "ArrowDown") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const dir = event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowDown" ? -1 : 1;
    publish(form.value + dir * 10);
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => event.preventDefault());
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof seedValue = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const form = html`<form class="kde-field">
    <span id="kde-seed-label">Seed</span>
    <input name="entry" type="number" step="1" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" aria-labelledby="kde-seed-label">
    <p class="kde-field-note"></p>
  </form>`;
  const note = form.querySelector(".kde-field-note");
  form.entry.value = String(api.DEFAULTS.seed);
  form.value = api.DEFAULTS.seed;
  const commit = () => {
    if (form.entry.value.trim() === "") {
      note.textContent = "The seed is empty. The sample was not redrawn.";
      form.entry.value = String(form.value);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = Number(form.entry.value);
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsed)) {
      note.textContent = "The seed must be an integer. The sample was not redrawn.";
      form.entry.value = String(form.value);
      return;
    }
    const wrapped = parsed >>> 0;
    note.textContent = parsed === wrapped ? "" : "Stored as an unsigned 32-bit integer, so " + parsed + " uses the same sequence as " + wrapped + ".";
    form.entry.value = String(wrapped);
    form.value = wrapped;
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  form.entry.addEventListener("change", commit);
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    commit();
  });
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
kdeActions = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const wrap = html`<form class="kde-actions">
    <button type="button" name="newer">New sample</button>
    <button type="button" name="silver">Use Silverman h</button>
    <button type="button" name="reset">Reset</button>
  </form>`;
  const poke = (form, value) => {
    if (form.slider) form.slider.value = String(value);
    if (form.out) {
      form.out.value = String(value);
      form.out.textContent = String(value);
    }
    if (form.entry) form.entry.value = String(value);
    if (form.choice) form.choice.value = value;
    form.value = value;
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  const setBandwidth = (value) => {
    const form = viewof bandwidth;
    form.slider.min = String(Math.min(0.02, value));
    form.slider.max = String(Math.max(2.5, value));
    form.slider.value = String(value);
    form.number.value = Number(value).toFixed(4);
    form.querySelector(".kde-field-note").textContent = "";
    form.value = value;
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  wrap.newer.addEventListener("click", () => {
    poke(viewof seedValue, (Number(seedValue) + 1) >>> 0);
    viewof seedValue.querySelector(".kde-field-note").textContent = "";
  });
  wrap.silver.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (draws.error) return;
    const ruled = api.silvermanNrd0(draws.values);
    if (!ruled.error) setBandwidth(ruled.value);
  });
  wrap.reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const seq = api.sequence(api.DEFAULTS.seed);
    const drawn = api.samplePrefix(seq, api.DEFAULTS.population, api.DEFAULTS.n);
    const ruled = api.silvermanNrd0(drawn.values);
    poke(viewof populationId, api.DEFAULTS.population);
    poke(viewof drawCount, api.DEFAULTS.n);
    poke(viewof seedValue, api.DEFAULTS.seed);
    viewof seedValue.querySelector(".kde-field-note").textContent = "";
    if (!ruled.error) setBandwidth(ruled.value);
    for (const key of ["bias", "variance", "mise", "ise"]) viewof seriesOn[key].checked = true;
    viewof seriesOn.value = ["bias", "variance", "mise", "ise"];
    viewof seriesOn.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof seriesOn = {
  const items = [
    ["bias", "Integrated squared bias"],
    ["variance", "Integrated variance"],
    ["mise", "MISE"],
    ["ise", "This sample's ISE"],
  ];
  const form = html`<form class="kde-toggles" aria-label="Panel B series"></form>`;
  for (const [key, label] of items) {
    const box = document.createElement("input");
    box.type = "checkbox";
    box.name = key;
    box.checked = true;
    const item = document.createElement("label");
    item.append(box, document.createTextNode(" " + label));
    form.appendChild(item);
  }
  const read = () => items.filter(([key]) => form[key].checked).map(([key]) => key);
  form.value = read();
  form.addEventListener("change", () => {
    form.value = read();
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => event.preventDefault());
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
draws = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  if (!Number.isInteger(seedValue)) return { error: "The seed must be an integer. No sample was drawn." };
  const dist = api.population(populationId);
  if (dist.error) return dist;
  const seq = api.sequence(seedValue);
  if (seq.error) return seq;
  const drawn = api.samplePrefix(seq, populationId, drawCount);
  if (drawn.error) return drawn;
  return { values: drawn.values, components: dist.components, n: drawCount, population: dist, seed: seedValue >>> 0 };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
pairWork = draws.error ? draws : kdeApi.pairCache(draws.values)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
drawsSettled = {
  const snapshot = draws;
  const work = pairWork;
  await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 100);
    invalidation.then(() => clearTimeout(timer));
  });
  return { snapshot, work };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
riskCurves = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const settled = drawsSettled;
  if (settled.snapshot.error) return settled.snapshot;
  if (settled.work.error) return settled.work;
  const components = settled.snapshot.components;
  const n = settled.snapshot.n;
  const cache = settled.work;
  const grid = api.bandwidthGrid(api.BAND_LO, api.BAND_HI, api.CURVE_COUNT);
  if (grid.error) return grid;
  const ise = api.iseCurve(cache, grid, components);
  if (ise.error) return ise;
  const mise = api.miseCurve(n, grid, components);
  if (mise.error) return mise;
  const minIse = api.minimiseRisk((band) => {
    const row = api.iseFromCache(cache, band, components);
    return row.error ? row : { value: row.value };
  }, api.BAND_LO, api.BAND_HI, api.CURVE_COUNT, api.ISE_FINE);
  if (minIse.error) return minIse;
  const minMise = api.minimiseRisk((band) => {
    const row = api.miseParts(n, band, components);
    return row.error ? row : { value: row.mise };
  }, api.BAND_LO, api.BAND_HI, 31, api.MISE_STEP);
  if (minMise.error) return minMise;
  return {
    grid,
    ise: ise.values,
    variance: mise.integratedVariance,
    bias: mise.integratedSquaredBias,
    mise: mise.mise,
    minIse,
    minMise,
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
labReadout = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const variant = (document.querySelector("[data-kde-variant]") || {}).getAttribute?.("data-kde-variant") || "embed";
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "kde-readout";
  root.dataset.kdeVariant = variant;
  const lines = [];
  const alerts = [];
  const add = (text, fail = false) => lines.push({ text, fail });
  if (draws.error || pairWork.error) {
    alerts.push(draws.error || pairWork.error);
  } else {
    const ruled = api.silvermanNrd0(draws.values);
    const ise = api.iseFromCache(pairWork, bandwidth, draws.components);
    const risk = api.miseParts(draws.n, bandwidth, draws.components);
    add(`${draws.population.label}: ${draws.population.detail}. n = ${draws.n} of ${api.MAX_N} from seed ${draws.seed}. Bandwidth h = ${viewFns.formatNumber(bandwidth)}.`);
    if (ruled.error) alerts.push("Silverman (R bw.nrd0) was not computed: " + ruled.error);
    else add(`Silverman (R bw.nrd0) = ${viewFns.formatNumber(ruled.value)}. ${api.SILVERMAN_RULE}`);
    if (ise.error) alerts.push("Integrated squared error was not computed: " + ise.error);
    else {
      let sentence = `ISE = ${viewFns.formatNumber(ise.value)}. Exact for a Gaussian kernel and this Gaussian mixture, in floating point, not a numerical integral. This is the error of the sample on the plot.`;
      if (ise.value < 0) sentence += " The value is negative, which the identity should not produce. It is shown as computed.";
      add(sentence);
    }
    if (risk.error) alerts.push("MISE was not computed: " + risk.error);
    else {
      add(`Integrated variance = ${viewFns.formatNumber(risk.integratedVariance)}. Integrated squared bias = ${viewFns.formatNumber(risk.integratedSquaredBias)}. MISE = ${viewFns.formatNumber(risk.mise)}.`);
      add("MISE is the expected ISE. At this n and this population it does not move when the sample changes. ISE does.");
      if (risk.integratedVariance < -1e-8 || risk.integratedSquaredBias < -1e-8) {
        alerts.push("A risk term is negative by more than roundoff. The value is shown as computed and was not replaced.");
      }
    }
    root.dataset.seed = String(draws.seed);
    root.dataset.n = String(draws.n);
    root.dataset.h = String(bandwidth);
    root.dataset.population = draws.population.id;
    root.dataset.sample = draws.values.slice(0, 8).map((v) => v.toPrecision(12)).join(",");
  }
  for (const line of lines) {
    const p = document.createElement("p");
    p.textContent = line.text;
    root.appendChild(p);
  }
  const alert = document.createElement("p");
  alert.className = "kde-fail";
  alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
  alert.textContent = alerts.join(" ");
  root.appendChild(alert);
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
densityChart = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const section = document.createElement("section");
  section.className = "kde-panel";
  const title = document.createElement("h3");
  title.className = "kde-panel-title";
  title.textContent = "Panel A. Estimate";
  section.appendChild(title);
  if (draws.error) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "kde-fail";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = draws.error;
    section.appendChild(alert);
    return section;
  }
  const [xMin, xMax] = viewFns.supportWindow(draws.values, draws.components);
  const xs = viewFns.densityGrid(xMin, xMax, draws.values);
  const truth = xs.map((x) => ({ x, y: api.mixturePdf(x, draws.components) }));
  const estimated = api.kdeOnGrid(xs, draws.values, bandwidth);
  let clipped = false;
  let estimate = null;
  if (!estimated.error) {
    const trueMax = truth.reduce((m, row) => Math.max(m, row.y), 0);
    const cap = Math.max(trueMax, 1e-6) * 4;
    estimate = xs.map((x, i) => ({ x, y: estimated.values[i] }));
    clipped = estimate.some((row) => row.y > cap);
  }
  const yTop = viewFns.topOf(truth, estimate, clipped);
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.max(280, width),
    height: viewFns.chartHeight(width),
    style: viewFns.plotStyle(themeColors),
    x: { label: "x", domain: [xMin, xMax], grid: true },
    y: { label: "density", domain: [0, yTop], grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.line(truth, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: themeColors.truth, strokeDasharray: "7 4", strokeWidth: 2 }),
      estimate ? Plot.line(estimate, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: themeColors.estimate, strokeWidth: 2.25 }) : null,
      Plot.tickX(draws.values.map((x) => ({ x })), { x: "x", stroke: themeColors.rug }),
    ].filter(Boolean),
  });
  chart.setAttribute("role", "img");
  chart.setAttribute("aria-label", `True density and Gaussian kernel estimate for ${draws.n} observations at bandwidth ${viewFns.formatNumber(bandwidth)}.`);
  const frame = document.createElement("div");
  frame.className = "kde-chart";
  frame.appendChild(chart);
  section.appendChild(frame);
  section.appendChild(viewFns.legendList([
    ["kde-swatch-true", "True density"],
    ["kde-swatch-est", "Gaussian kernel estimate"],
    ["kde-swatch-rug", "Sample"],
  ]));
  if (estimated.error) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "kde-fail";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = "The kernel curve was not drawn: " + estimated.error;
    section.appendChild(alert);
  } else if (clipped) {
    const note = document.createElement("p");
    note.className = "kde-hint";
    note.textContent = "The estimate exceeds the top of the plot. The axis stops at 4 times the true density so that curve stays visible.";
    section.appendChild(note);
  }
  return section;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
riskChart = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const section = document.createElement("section");
  section.className = "kde-panel";
  const title = document.createElement("h3");
  title.className = "kde-panel-title";
  title.textContent = "Panel B. Risk against bandwidth";
  section.appendChild(title);
  if (riskCurves.error) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "kde-fail";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = riskCurves.error;
    section.appendChild(alert);
    return section;
  }
  const chosen = new Set(seriesOn);
  const rows = riskCurves.grid.map((band, i) => ({
    h: band,
    bias: riskCurves.bias[i],
    variance: riskCurves.variance[i],
    mise: riskCurves.mise[i],
    ise: riskCurves.ise[i],
  }));
  let yMax = 0;
  let yMin = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    for (const key of chosen) {
      if (row[key] > yMax) yMax = row[key];
      if (row[key] < yMin) yMin = row[key];
    }
  }
  if (!(yMax > yMin)) yMax = yMin + 1;
  const silver = draws.error ? { error: draws.error } : api.silvermanNrd0(draws.values);
  const xValues = rows.map((row) => row.h);
  if (Number.isFinite(bandwidth)) xValues.push(bandwidth);
  if (silver.value) xValues.push(silver.value);
  const xLo = Math.min(api.BAND_LO, ...xValues);
  const xHi = Math.max(api.BAND_HI, ...xValues);
  const marks = [];
  const style = {
    bias: { stroke: themeColors.bias, strokeDasharray: "2 2" },
    variance: { stroke: themeColors.variance, strokeDasharray: "7 4" },
    mise: { stroke: themeColors.mise, strokeWidth: 2.4 },
    ise: { stroke: themeColors.ise, strokeDasharray: "5 2 1 2" },
  };
  for (const key of ["bias", "variance", "mise", "ise"]) {
    if (!chosen.has(key)) continue;
    marks.push(Plot.line(rows, { x: "h", y: key, ...style[key] }));
    const at = rows.reduce((best, row) => Math.abs(row.h - bandwidth) < Math.abs(best.h - bandwidth) ? row : best, rows[0]);
    if (Number.isFinite(at[key])) marks.push(Plot.dot([{ h: bandwidth, y: at[key] }], { x: "h", y: "y", fill: style[key].stroke, r: 3.5 }));
  }
  const markers = [
    { x: riskCurves.minMise.x, text: "min MISE", stroke: themeColors.mise, dash: "0" },
    { x: riskCurves.minIse.x, text: "min ISE", stroke: themeColors.ise, dash: "6 3" },
  ];
  if (silver.value) markers.push({ x: silver.value, text: "Silverman", stroke: themeColors.silver, dash: "2 2" });
  markers.push({ x: bandwidth, text: "h", stroke: themeColors.estimate, dash: "1 3" });
  markers.forEach((marker, index) => {
    marks.push(Plot.ruleX([marker.x], { stroke: marker.stroke, strokeDasharray: marker.dash }));
    marks.push(Plot.text([{ x: marker.x, y: yMax, text: marker.text }], {
      x: "x", y: "y", text: "text", dy: 12 + index * 14, textAnchor: "start", fill: themeColors.text,
    }));
  });
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.max(280, width),
    height: viewFns.chartHeight(width),
    style: viewFns.plotStyle(themeColors),
    x: { label: "bandwidth h", domain: [xLo, xHi], grid: true },
    y: { label: "risk", domain: [Math.min(0, yMin), yMax * 1.08], grid: true },
    marks,
  });
  chart.setAttribute("role", "img");
  chart.setAttribute("aria-label", `Risk against bandwidth. Minimum MISE on the grid at ${viewFns.formatNumber(riskCurves.minMise.x)}. Minimum ISE on the grid at ${viewFns.formatNumber(riskCurves.minIse.x)}.`);
  const frame = document.createElement("div");
  frame.className = "kde-chart";
  frame.appendChild(chart);
  section.appendChild(frame);
  section.appendChild(viewFns.legendList([
    ["kde-swatch-bias", "Integrated squared bias, rises with h"],
    ["kde-swatch-var", "Integrated variance, falls with h"],
    ["kde-swatch-mise", "MISE"],
    ["kde-swatch-ise", "This sample's ISE"],
  ]));
  const note = document.createElement("p");
  note.className = "kde-hint";
  note.textContent = `Markers are grid minima, not a closed-form argmin. min MISE is the smallest MISE from ${api.BAND_LO} to ${api.BAND_HI} at steps of ${api.MISE_STEP}. min ISE is the smallest ISE on that window after a step of ${api.ISE_FINE}. The series share one vertical scale. Hide one if it flattens the others. ISE can sit far from MISE. Neither is known when the true density is unknown.`;
  section.appendChild(note);
  const slot = document.querySelector("[data-kde-variant]");
  if (!slot || slot.getAttribute("data-kde-variant") !== "projector") {
    const open = document.createElement("p");
    open.className = "kde-open";
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="quarto:offset"]');
    const offset = meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "./";
    link.href = offset + "labs/kernel-density.html";
    link.textContent = "Open the laboratory page";
    open.appendChild(link);
    section.appendChild(open);
  }
  return section;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
viewFns = {
  function formatNumber(value) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "not finite";
    const magnitude = Math.abs(value);
    if (magnitude !== 0 && (magnitude < 1e-3 || magnitude >= 1000)) return value.toExponential(4);
    return value.toPrecision(4);
  }
  function chartHeight(px) {
    return Math.max(240, Math.round(Math.min(px, 760) * 0.5));
  }
  function plotStyle(colors) {
    return {
      color: colors.text,
      background: "transparent",
      fontFamily: '-apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif',
      fontSize: "12px",
    };
  }
  function supportWindow(values, components) {
    let lo = Infinity;
    let hi = -Infinity;
    for (const component of components) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, component.mean - 4 * component.sd);
      hi = Math.max(hi, component.mean + 4 * component.sd);
    }
    for (const x of values) {
      if (x < lo) lo = x;
      if (x > hi) hi = x;
    }
    return [lo - 0.45, hi + 0.45];
  }
  function densityGrid(xMin, xMax, values) {
    const xs = [];
    const steps = 280;
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) xs.push(xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps);
    for (const x of values) xs.push(x);
    xs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const out = [];
    for (const x of xs) {
      if (x < xMin || x > xMax) continue;
      if (!out.length || x - out[out.length - 1] > 1e-8) out.push(x);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function topOf(truth, estimate, clipped) {
    const trueMax = truth.reduce((m, row) => Math.max(m, row.y), 0);
    let kdeMax = 0;
    if (estimate) for (const row of estimate) if (row.y > kdeMax) kdeMax = row.y;
    const cap = Math.max(trueMax, 1e-6) * 4;
    const shown = clipped ? Math.min(kdeMax, cap) : Math.max(trueMax, kdeMax);
    return Math.max(shown, 1e-6) * 1.08;
  }
  function legendList(items) {
    const list = document.createElement("ul");
    list.className = "kde-legend";
    for (const [swatch, text] of items) {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      const mark = document.createElement("span");
      mark.className = "kde-swatch " + swatch;
      mark.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      item.append(mark, document.createTextNode(text));
      list.appendChild(item);
    }
    return list;
  }
  return { formatNumber, chartHeight, plotStyle, supportWindow, densityGrid, topOf, legendList };
}
```
